title: GTM Engineer - Sales Operations CRM Management
description: As the GTM Engineer - Sales Operations CRM Management (m/w/d), you will own the systems that run sales and marketing across PERGOLUX's global operations, with HubSpot as the single source of truth, Aircall and WhatsApp as the conversation layer, and the integrations that connect them to Shopify, Klaviyo and our data warehouse. You turn business problems into working configuration, automation and integrations across 11+ markets, and you make sure what you build is documented, adopted and measured. Reporting to the Head of Sales Operations, you work daily with Sales Leads in each market, Sales Enablement, Data and Analytics, and the Marketing team. PERGOLUX designs and sells premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from aluminium pergolas to garden furniture, direct to consumers. We are a company of around 300 people generating 9-figure revenue, operating across 8 markets and growing steadily across Europe and beyond. What You'll Do - Administer and evolve our multi-market HubSpot portal: objects, properties, pipelines, lifecycle stages, permissions and teams, plus workflows, lead routing, assignment rules and per-market task queues, while keeping data quality high through deduplication, property governance and regular audits. - Own Aircall configuration (numbers, IVRs, routing, ring groups, overflow per market) and the Aircall–HubSpot integration, so every call, recording, outcome and AI summary lands on the right record, and support call pick-up SLAs and Conversation Intelligence for coaching and quality programmes. - Configure and integrate WhatsApp and messaging platforms (Rasayel, Superchat) with HubSpot routing and reporting, and own the Shopify–HubSpot data flow for orders, payments and customers alongside integration partners. - Connect HubSpot with Klaviyo, Zendesk, GA4 and our Snowflake/Looker warehouse, and build lightweight automations using REST APIs, webhooks, custom code actions and iPaaS tools (Make, Zapier, n8n), including scoping and implementing new GTM and AI tooling with a clear business case. - Design the MQL to SQL handover with Marketing (lead scoring, routing, SLAs, attribution), map and document the end-to-end customer lifecycle, write clear SOPs, train Sales Leads, reps and outsourced partners, and manage change requests through a Jira backlog. What You'll Bring - 3–5+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops or GTM engineering, with hands-on HubSpot admin experience in a multi-team or multi-market portal, including deep knowledge of the data model, workflows, lead routing, custom objects, permissions and reporting. - Practical experience configuring a cloud telephony tool (Aircall preferred) and its CRM integration, plus integration skills across REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and at least one iPaaS tool (Make, Zapier, n8n, Workato). - Solid data skills: clean data modelling and confidence reconciling numbers across systems, with a track record of working with Marketing on lead management, scoring and attribution. - The ability to translate messy business needs into simple, documented solutions, and to say no or "not yet" with a clear reason. Fluent English and comfort working with teams across Europe, the US and Australia. - Nice to have: German, French or Italian; experience with Shopify or e-commerce order data in a CRM; scripting in JavaScript or Python; experience with Klaviyo, Zendesk, WhatsApp Business platforms, Snowflake/Looker, AI agents in a GTM context, or supporting outsourced sales teams. Apply through our [Career Page]( https://pergolux.careers/ ) or connect with us on [LinkedIn]( https://www.linkedin.com/company/pergolux/posts/?feedView=all ). title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – 6 Months Contract (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us on a 6-month contract, and start as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks. What you will do: Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting. Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing. Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation. Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported. Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug. Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface. Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin. Who you are: You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end. You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS. You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech. You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar). You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines. You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership. You are available to start at short notice. Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure. You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company. You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe. You will get a competitive salary. Our hiring team for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov. For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology? title: Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer - Planning, Decision & Intercept
description: Building autonomous supremacy systems in Berlin Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. We design tightly integrated autonomy stacks in Europe to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces, focusing on defensive and counter-system capabilities including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions. We are looking for a Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer to build the intelligence that turns mission objectives, target information and vehicle state into executable autonomous behaviour. Your mission with us Build the autonomy layer of our high-speed aerial robotic systems. Convert mission objectives, target state and vehicle state into real-time actions and trajectories. Develop algorithms for dynamic rendezvous, pursuit, interception and terminal approach. Build target-motion prediction and intercept-point estimation for moving airborne targets. Develop real-time path planning, trajectory generation and replanning under uncertainty. Account for aircraft capabilities, energy, maneuverability, sensing uncertainty and changing target behaviour. Build decision and behaviour logic that allows the system to adapt continuously during a mission. Combine classical robotics, optimization, MPC and learned approaches where appropriate. Explore reinforcement learning, imitation learning and policy-based autonomy where they provide meaningful advantages. Work closely with perception, estimation and control engineers to close the autonomy loop. Take algorithms from simulation into real aircraft and validate them through repeated flight testing. Your contribution to the team (required) Strong robotics or autonomous-systems background with significant real-world deployment experience. Strong experience with motion planning, trajectory generation or autonomous decision-making. Deep understanding of kinematics, dynamics and optimization. Experience with dynamic environments and moving-target problems. Experience with trajectory optimization, optimal control, MPC or comparable approaches. Strong C++ skills and good Python skills. Experience deploying autonomy algorithms onto real robotic systems. Strong understanding of uncertainty and its implications for decision-making and planning. Ability to design algorithms that operate under real-time compute constraints. Hands-on attitude and willingness to participate directly in flight testing and system debugging. Big plus UAV / fixed-wing autonomy. High-speed aerial robotics. Rendezvous, pursuit or intercept problems. Target-motion prediction. Aggressive flight. Reinforcement learning on real robots. Imitation learning / learned policies. PX4. ROS2. Optimal control and trajectory optimization. Aviation, defence or space systems. title: UI/UX Designer (w/m/d)
description: Einleitung Wir sind auf der Suche nach neuen Kollegen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Prozess der Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht, unserer juristischen Kompetenz und einem starken Team von zahlreichen Mitarbeitern begleiten wir tausende Mandanten erfolgreich auf dem Weg zur deutschen Staatsbürgerschaft. Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich einen Einblick unter migrando(.)de/karriere, unserer Karriere-Page. Denn wir können hier schreiben was wir wollen, im Endeffekt bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung. Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast . Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang in der Praxis gearbeitet und Hands-on-Erfahrungen gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Wir bieten Dir Unser Produkt ist rein digital – das bedeutet, jede Designentscheidung ist messbar, jede Verbesserung sofort sichtbar. Du arbeitest nicht im Dunkeln, sondern mit echten Nutzerdaten, echtem Traffic und echtem Feedback. Und du gestaltest nicht nur nach außen: Auch unsere internen Tools und Workflows brauchen jemanden, der das Nutzererlebnis im Blick behält. High-End Hardware nach Wahl Egal ob MacBook oder Windows Tower. Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, inkl. 4K-Monitoren. Große Reichweite Über die Jahre haben wir mit unserer Plattform bereits sehr viele Menschen erreicht. Diese Menge an realem Traffic bedeutet für dich: Du siehst die Auswirkung deiner Arbeit schnell – und kannst daraus genauso schnell lernen. Echte Eigenverantwortung Du bist nicht Umsetzer fremder Ideen. Du kannst deine eigenen Perspektiven bringen, Designentscheidungen auf Basis von Daten treffen und hast einen direkten Draht zu den anderen Teams und der Geschäftsführung. Kleine Teams statt Großraumbüro Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt und schnell ins Gespräch kommt. Musik bei der Arbeit Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und keinen anderen stört), kannst du auch gerne Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen. Modernes Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen in den Räumen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch. Einen Einblick in unsere Räumlichkeiten kannst du dir auf unserer Website anschauen. Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit moderner Ausstattung Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung. Homeoffice-Möglichkeit Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Gleichzeitig ist Home Office jederzeit möglich. Auch spontan und ohne lange Abstimmung. Vertrauensarbeitszeit ohne Kernzeiten Bei uns gibt es keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster, in denen du anwesend sein musst. Flexible Teilzeitmodelle Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell. Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum. Spontan Urlaub nehmen Manchmal braucht man einfach eine Auszeit. Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familienfreundliche Kultur Kranke Kinder, Elternabend oder kurzfristiger Arzttermin – wir wissen, dass solche Situationen zum Alltag gehören. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang. Kurze Wege Bei uns musst du dich nicht durch die Hierarchien hangeln oder lange Mails schreiben, um gehört zu werden. Du kannst jederzeit direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung sprechen. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Austausch ist direkt und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“. Mitgestalten statt nur abarbeiten Wir suchen Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen kann, ein Tool sinnvoll wäre oder ein Workflow smarter funktionieren könnte, dann wirst du gehört. Sinnstiftende Arbeit Deine Tätigkeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit – es ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung und spürbarer Wirkung. Feel-Good-Angebote im Haus Unsere Feel-Good-Managerin sorgt regelmäßig für kleine Auszeiten – von Nacken- und Schultermassagen über kurze Entspannungs- und Beauty-Sessions bis hin zu Momenten zum Durchatmen. Regelmäßige Team-Events Wir feiern gern. Sommerfest am See, gemütliche Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner mit der Abteilung. Unsere Events sorgen dafür, dass wir als Team zusammenwachsen und den Arbeitsalltag auch mal beiseiteschieben können. Aber keine Sorge: Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht und eher Gehen auch kein Problem. Fitnessraum im Haus Unser eigener Fitnessraum steht dir direkt im Haus zur Verfügung – kostenlos, gut ausgestattet und jederzeit zugänglich. Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche Wie verhalten sich User auf unserer Website? Wo springen sie ab, wo zögern sie, wo verstehen sie nicht, was als nächstes zu tun ist? Diese Fragen treibt dich an – und du beantwortest sie nicht mit Bauchgefühl, sondern mit Methode. Konzeption & Design von User Interfaces Du erstellst (oder bist beteiligt an der Erstellung von) Wireframes und Prototypen in Figma – für unsere Haupt-Websites, Landingpages und Apps. User Journey Mapping & Optimierung Du analysierst die komplette Customer Journey – vom ersten Klick bis zur erfolgreichen Einbürgerung und Kundenbewertung – und sorgst dafür, dass unnötige Reibungspunkte, Kontaktanfragen und Bedenken verschwinden. Conversion Rate Optimization Du planst, implementierst und analysierst A/B-Tests (z. B. zur Optimierung von Formularen oder Call-to-Actions), um die Abschlussrate zu steigern. Design System Management Du baust unser zentrales Design System in Figma weiter auf, pflegst es und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Frontend-Team weiter, damit alles konsistent und skalierbar bleibt. Entwicklung mobiler Erlebnisse Du stellst sicher, dass alle Interfaces auf mobilen Geräten perfekt funktionieren – mit Mobile-First-Ansatz, Fokus auf Touch-Interaktionen und optimaler Performance (Kann die Website auch von einem User, der gerade zur Arbeit pendelt, zufriedenstellend genutzt werden?) Usability-Testing & Research Du bist der Ansprechpartner für Usability-Testing (Eye-Tracking-Analysen, User-Interviews, regelmäßige Gespräche mit anderen kundennahen Teams), damit unsere Design-Entscheidungen auf echten Daten und Nutzerfeedback basieren. Kollaboration mit Marketing & Content Du arbeitest mit dem Marketing-Team zusammen, um visuell starke Landingpages, Kampagnen und Social-Media-Grafiken umzusetzen. Du weißt, was Nutzer anspricht und bewegt und wo ihre Bedenken liegen. Tracking & Datenanalyse Du richtest Tracking-Events (z. B. via Google Analytics, Hubspot) ein oder wertest sie mit aus, um aus echten Nutzungsdaten Designentscheidungen abzuleiten. Prozessoptimierung & UX-Standards Du entwickelst Standards, Templates und Workflows, die die Design-Arbeit für das gesamte Team effizienter machen. Dein Profil Kein Zertifikat der Welt ersetzt echte Erfahrung und Know-How aus der Praxis. Genau die suchen wir. Ob du dein Können im Job, in eigenen Projekten oder auf eigene Faust unter Beweis gestellt hast – uns interessiert, was du wirklich kannst und wie du denkst. Direkte Kommunikation und Hand-on-Erfahrung sind uns wichtiger als jeder Abschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. description: Join SE3 Labs as Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer Join our new Software Platform team and make the devices, networks and compute behind SE3's autonomy run reliably, so our engineers can focus on what they do best. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Software Platform team , help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field. You'll work on-site in Munich alongside our cybersecurity engineer and the CV, robotics and firmware teams, with occasional visits to our second site. What You'll Work On Over-the-Air Updates: Unify our separate update and software distribution setups for Jetson, NXP and other edge nodes into one reliable system for every platform. Device Provisioning: Provision, configure and maintain Linux-based edge devices, workstations and ground systems, including ARM64 platforms. Deployment Automation: Build reproducible container images, deployments, device configuration, release workflows and recovery procedures, with Bash and Python tooling. Networks & Remote Access: Design and troubleshoot connectivity across networked and remote devices, including routing, SSH, VPNs, firewalls and constrained field links. Compute Cluster & CI: Make our GPU compute and evaluation cluster and self-hosted CI runners reliable, so engineers can depend on them without manual recovery. WeVote is a nonpartisan get-out-the-vote nonprofit startup and a celebrated Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. WeVote is a movement of over 160 active passionate, part-time volunteers (starting with the founders) who build mobile technologies that will touch and mobilize millions of voters on Election Day. We believe that many voters are busy, distracted, and impatient. We have a goal of providing a positive voting experience that helps people decide how to vote. More information at https://WeVote.US or @WeVote on X. Vote USA Platform Vote USA is built with .Net. There are actually two sites, a public site and a gated admin site. They have separate code bases but share a C# library. All development is done in Visual Studio on an AWS workstation, with development sites hosted on a local instance of IIS. The live versions of each are hosted on AWS EC2 instances – a single instance for the admin site and a pair of load-balanced instances for the public site. The number and size of the load-balanced servers can be increased during periods of heavy demand (just before major elections). There is also a staging server for the public site. This is primarily to review changes before they go live. New versions of the admin, public and staging sites are published via .msi files. These are created on the workstation but accessible to the EC2 instances. The database is hosted on AWS RDS MySQL. There are two instances, a prod instance used by the public, staging and admin servers and a test instance used by the development versions of each. What You'll Do Implement new enhancements. Fix occasional bugs. Add, update, and maintain shape files which are used to construct each voter’s customized ballots based on their postal address. Shape files are used to convert postal addresses into geographical latitude and longitude parameters, which in turn, are then used to determine the various office contests on ballots. Respond to AWS server maintenance requirements, like system software sunsets, i.e. the MySQL version we were using. Coordinate with WeVote’s engineers to enable Vote USA’s data to be integrated into WeVote’s platform. Participate in weekly Zoom meetings. Who you are: Must haves. You want to work with an established and successful team. You are committed to strengthening American Democracy. You are striving for personal excellence, and want to do meaningful work that will make a difference. 10+ hours per week during our core team hours M-F 8 a.m. - 6 p.m. (in your own time zone) A willingness to work with and support other volunteers. How to apply: Submit your resume (at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply/) and include a brief note/cover letter to why you are interested in WeVote and helping our mission.
